name: ankle v1
note: ankle v1 (2026-10-13), for ankle_v1_post.py / ankle_v1_field.py, appended after P-neck3. Anatomy review 2026-10-13 findings 4 and 13; Nick, 2026-10-13: "Yes, fix all ten of them." Written for the +x leg; the -x leg uses it mirrored on its own grid. sweep: elliptic tapered capsules through the shin's measured center line (z, x, y, half widths rx and ry), hard-unioned, the last segment near vertical so the leg comes down onto the heel centered; joinK: the sweep joined to the skin (adds only where the old ankle is thinner); blurZ: a z-only blur over the ankle that evens the radius profile; blurs: the shin-to-instep corner (fillet), the ring where the shin meets the foot, and the front of the lower shin (the rope ridge); partBox: |x| from .18 (in by .20), z below -.66 (in by -.70), so the knee (z -.557) and everything above it is outside. World units, +y back.
